title: Travel Diaries of Xu Xiake
subtitle: 34 Years Hiking Across China · 80+ National Heritage Sites
description: Follow the footsteps of Ming Dynasty traveler Xu Xiake, from the Jiangnan water towns to the southwest frontier, exploring the historic buildings and natural wonders that witnessed the legendary journey of the "Sage of Travel."

title: Commentary on the Water Classic
subtitle: 1,252 Rivers and Their Ancient Sites · First-hand Northern Dynasties Architecture
description: Li Daoyuan used waterways as his framework, recording ancient sites, cities, buildings, and inscriptions along 1,252 rivers across China. A treasure trove for studying pre-Tang architectural remains, linked to over 100 national heritage sites.

title: The Monasteries of Luoyang
subtitle: Northern Wei Luoyang's Thousand Temples · Buddhist Architectural History
description: Yang Xuanzhi's account of Northern Wei Luoyang, where 1,367 Buddhist temples once stood. The nine-story wooden pagoda of Yongning Temple, the Jingming Temple, the Yaoguang Temple, the White Horse Temple — the glory and destruction of a Buddhist capital.

title: Great Tang Records on the Western Regions
subtitle: Xuanzang's 25,000-Mile Journey · The Bible of Western Region Archaeology
description: Dictated by the monk Xuanzang and compiled by Bianji — from Chang'an through the Hexi Corridor, the Tianshan Mountains, Central Asia, and into India, recording the customs and architecture of 110 kingdoms. The essential guide for explorers like Stein.

title: Journey to Shu
subtitle: Lu You's Yangtze River Diary · A Complete Record of Song Dynasty Architecture
description: In 1170, Lu You traveled upstream along the Yangtze from Shanyin to Kuizhou. His detailed diary records temples, towers, and ancient city ruins in Zhenjiang, Jinling, Wuhan, Yichang, and Baidi City.

title: Wuchuan Record
subtitle: Fan Chengda's Homeward Boat Diary · Architecture from the Southwest to Jiangnan
description: In 1177, Fan Chengda sailed east from Chengdu to Lin'an, passing Meishan, Chongqing, Yichang, Wuhan, Jiujiang, Nanjing, and Zhenjiang, recording temples, cliff carvings, and scenic spots along the way.

title: Dreams of Splendor of the Eastern Capital
subtitle: The Urban Memory of Northern Song Bianliang · Key Document of Song City Architecture
description: Meng Yuanlao's retrospective of the Eastern Capital Bianliang — imperial palaces, market streets, the Daxiangguo Temple, Jinming Lake, the Rainbow Bridge night market. A literary version of Along the River During the Qingming Festival.

title: Old Stories of Wulin
subtitle: The Urban Memory of Southern Song Lin'an · A Complete View of Hangzhou's Ancient Architecture
description: Zhou Mi's recollection of Southern Song Lin'an (Hangzhou) — its palaces, gardens, temples, taverns, and festivals. The Ten Scenes of West Lake, Lingyin Temple, Jingci Temple, Liuhe Pagoda, Yue Fei Temple.

title: The Travels of Marco Polo
subtitle: Yuan Dynasty China Through European Eyes · An Architectural Grand Tour
description: The Venetian merchant Marco Polo's account of Yuan Dynasty China — the magnificent palaces of Dadu, the beautiful stone lions of Lugou Bridge, the paradise of Hangzhou, the water towns of Suzhou.

title: Scenery and Monuments of the Imperial Capital
subtitle: A Complete Gazetteer of Ming Dynasty Beijing
description: Liu Dong and Yu Yizheng's Ming Dynasty gazetteer of Beijing — the Temple of Heaven, Imperial Ancestral Temple, Imperial Academy, Lugou Bridge, Fayuan Temple, Changchun Temple.

title: Chang'an Gazetteer
subtitle: The Earliest Surviving Gazetteer of Chang'an · A Panorama of Tang Dynasty Chang'an
description: Song Minqiu's earliest and most complete gazetteer of Chang'an — the palaces, wards, markets, temples, and gardens of Tang Chang'an vividly described.

title: Dream of the Red Chamber
subtitle: Searching for Heritage in Grand View Garden
description: Follow Cao Xueqin's literary masterpiece through the pavilions of Grand View Garden, the ancestral halls of the Jia family, and the mist-wrapped temples — discover the real-world architectural prototypes in Beijing, Suzhou, and Qufu.

title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms
subtitle: Heroes and Heritage · A Tour of Three Kingdoms Sites
description: Luo Guanzhong's epic of the Three Kingdoms — from the Peach Garden Oath to the Battle of Red Cliffs, from Jingzhou's ancient city to Chengdu's Wuhou Temple.

title: Journey to the West
subtitle: The 81 Tribulations Pilgrimage · Buddhist Sites Along the Silk Road
description: Wu Cheng'en's fantastical tale based on Xuanzang's pilgrimage — the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda, Small Wild Goose Pagoda, Xingjiao Temple Pagoda, Mogao Grottoes, Maijishan Grottoes, Gaochang Ancient City.

title: Water Margin
subtitle: The Outlaws of the Marsh · Ancient Architecture of Shandong, Henan, Hebei
description: Shi Nai'an's tale of 108 heroes — from the Liangshan marsh to Kaifeng's Daxiangguo Temple, from Yanggu's Jingyang Ridge to Mount Tai's Dai Temple.

title: Investiture of the Gods
subtitle: The Mythological Universe of Shang and Zhou · Yin Ruins and Zhouyuan Sites
description: Xu Zhonglin's epic of gods and heroes — from the Deer Terrace of Zhaoge to the Zhou Plain of Western Qi, from the Yin Ruins to the Duke of Zhou Temple.

title: Romance of the Sui and Tang Dynasties
subtitle: Heroic Epic of the Sui-Tang Transition · Chang'an, Luoyang, Yangzhou Sites
description: Chu Renhuo's tale of the Sui-Tang era — from Taiyuan's Jin Temple to Chang'an's Daming Palace, from Luoyang's Longmen Grottoes to Yangzhou's Grand Canal.

title: Stories Old and New
subtitle: Ming Dynasty Jiangnan's Urban Tapestry · Architecture of Suzhou and Hangzhou
description: Feng Menglong and Ling Mengchu's vernacular short stories — Suzhou gardens, Hangzhou's West Lake, Nanjing's Qinhuai River, Yangzhou's Slender West Lake.

title: The Scholars
subtitle: Qing Dynasty Literati Travels · Architecture of Nanjing and Yangzhou
description: Wu Jingzi's satirical novel of Qing Dynasty scholars — Nanjing's Confucius Temple and Jiangnan Examination Hall, the pavilions along the Qinhuai River, Yangzhou's salt merchant gardens.

title: The Story of Yue Fei
subtitle: A Heroic Epic of Loyalty · Yue Fei Memorial Sites Across China
description: Qian Cai's legendary tale of Yue Fei — from Hangzhou's Yue Fei Temple to Tangyin's Yue Fei Temple, from Zhuxian Town to Wuchang.

title: The Story of the Western Wing
subtitle: Love at Pujiu Temple · China's Most Romantic Monastery
description: Wang Shifu's masterpiece of Yuan drama — Zhang Sheng and Cui Yingying meet at Pujiu Temple in Yongji, Shanxi, transforming this Tang Dynasty monastery into an eternal shrine of love.

title: The Peony Pavilion
subtitle: Love That Transcends Death · Tang Xianzu's Hometown and Kunqu Stage
description: Tang Xianzu's Kunqu classic — Du Liniang dreams of love, dies for love, and is reborn through love. The Wenchang Lane of Tang Xianzu's former residence in Fuzhou, Jiangxi, and the ancient stage of the Shanxi-Shaanxi Guild Hall in Suzhou.

title: The Palace of Eternal Life
subtitle: The Love Story of Tang Minghuang and Yang Guifei
description: Hong Sheng's drama of Emperor Tang Minghuang and Yang Guifei — the warm springs of Huaqing Palace, the yellow earth of Mawei Slope, the whispered vows in the Palace of Eternal Life.

title: The Peach Blossom Fan
subtitle: Love and Ruin in the Late Ming Dynasty · Nanjing's Architectural Legacy
description: Kong Shangren's play set against the fall of the Ming Dynasty — the Qinhuai River by Nanjing's Confucius Temple, the sunset over the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum, the bells of Jiming Temple.

title: The Orphan of Zhao
subtitle: China's First Play Introduced to Europe · Sites of Loyalty in Yu County
description: Ji Junxiang's tale of loyalty and sacrifice — Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chujiu risk everything to save the orphan of the Zhao family. The hidden cave and gratitude temple in Yu County, Shanxi.

title: Records of the Grand Historian
subtitle: Sima Qian's Masterpiece · Architecture from Antiquity to Han Dynasty
description: Sima Qian's grand history — from the Mausoleum of the Yellow Emperor to the Yin Ruins, from the Duke of Zhou Temple to the Qin Shi Huang Mausoleum, from Maoling to the Confucius Temple.

title: Zuo's Commentary
subtitle: Cities and Wars of the Spring and Autumn Period · Capital Sites of the Vassal States
description: Zuo Qiuming's annalistic history — from the Lu State Ancient City in Qufu to the Qi State Ancient City in Linzi, from the Zheng Han Ancient City in Xinzheng to the Chu Jinan Ancient City in Jingzhou.

title: Strategies of the Warring States
subtitle: The Great Age of Strategists · Capital Sites of the Seven Kingdoms
description: Liu Xiang's compilation of Warring States rhetoric — the earthen platforms of Yanxiadu, the high terraces of Handan's Zhao King City. The capitals, walls, and tombs of the Seven Kingdoms.

title: Records of the Three Kingdoms
subtitle: The True History of Wei, Shu, and Wu · An Archaeological Journey
description: Chen Shou's historical masterpiece — the true source behind Romance of the Three Kingdoms. From Chengdu's Wuhou Temple to Mianxian's Wuhou Tomb, from the Han-Wei Luoyang Ancient City to Nanjing's Stone City.

title: Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government
subtitle: 1,362 Years of History Across 16 Dynasties
description: Sima Guang's monumental chronological history — from the Warring States to the Five Dynasties, covering 1,362 years. Countless palaces, tombs, temples, walls, and canals rise and fall across its pages.

title: Black Myth: Wukong
subtitle: Retracing the Journey West · Discovering Destiny in Ancient Architecture
description: Follow the Destined One of Black Myth: Wukong, from the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit to the Little Western Paradise, exploring the real ancient buildings scanned and recreated by Game Science.

title: Where Winds Meet
subtitle: The Wuxia Dream of Northern Song Kaifeng
description: NetEase's wuxia world of the Northern Song — Kaifeng's Fan Tower stunningly recreated, the Rainbow Bridge spanning the Bian River, the Daxiangguo Temple wrapped in incense smoke.

title: Genshin Impact
subtitle: Chinese Architecture in Liyue · Game Landscapes of Zhangjiajie and Guilin
description: miHoYo's Liyue region — Suzhou gardens for courtyards, Zhangjiajie for mountains, Guilin for waters, the Hanging Temple for pavilions, Tulou for settlements.

title: Honkai: Star Rail
subtitle: The Huizhou Fantasy of the Xianzhou Luofu
description: miHoYo's interstellar train — the Xianzhou Luofu built on Huizhou architecture. Horse-head walls, white walls and black tiles, carved window lattices, Suzhou corridors reborn in a sci-fi context.

title: Naraka: Bladepoint
subtitle: Deep Collaboration with the Terracotta Warriors · Qin Dynasty Architecture Arena
description: NetEase's martial arts battle royale — deep collaboration with the Emperor Qinshihuang's Mausoleum Site Museum, recreating terracotta warriors and Qin Dynasty palaces.

title: Justice
subtitle: Northern Song Architecture Reconstruction Project
description: NetEase's Song Dynasty wuxia world — the Daxiangguo Temple, Iron Pagoda, Leifeng Pagoda, Zhuozheng Garden, Longmen Grottoes recreated in-game.

title: The Legend of Sword and Fairy
subtitle: 30 Years of Chinese Classics · Shan Shui Architecture in the Wuxia Realm
description: Softstar's 30-year classic — the misty rain of Hangzhou's West Lake, the elegance of Suzhou gardens, the grandeur of Huangshan's sea of clouds, the solemnity of Dali's Three Pagodas.

title: The Great Wall
subtitle: Spanning 15 Provinces · UNESCO World Heritage
description: The Great Wall is an ancient Chinese military defense project, first built during the Spring and Autumn period, stretching approximately 21,000 km. Inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987.

title: The Grand Canal
subtitle: Flowing Through 8 Provinces · UNESCO World Heritage
description: The Grand Canal is one of ancient China's greatest water engineering projects, running from Beijing to Hangzhou for approximately 1,794 km. Inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2014.

title: Qin Straight Road
subtitle: Across Shaanxi, Gansu, Inner Mongolia · The World's Earliest Highway
description: A military expressway ordered by Qin Shi Huang in 212 BCE, stretching approximately 736 km with an average width of 30 meters — one of the three great Qin Dynasty projects.

title: Chinese Eastern Railway
subtitle: Across Heilongjiang, Jilin, Liaoning, Inner Mongolia · Modern Railway Heritage
description: Built by Russia in the late 19th century, this railway artery centered on Harbin spans nearly 2,500 km, leaving behind a rich legacy of Russian-style architecture along its route.

title: Great Wall of Qi
subtitle: Across 7 Cities in Shandong · The Father of the Great Wall
description: Predating the Qin Great Wall by over 400 years, the Qi Great Wall is China's oldest surviving Great Wall, stretching 641.32 km across 1,518 mountain peaks.

title: Ancient Tea Horse Road
subtitle: Across Yunnan, Sichuan, Tibet · A Corridor of Civilization on the Roof of the World
description: An ancient trade network in Southwest China using horse caravans, the Tea Horse Road is one of the world's highest and most treacherous ancient trade routes.
